WALKOUT NG MGA ESTUDYANTE NG MAPUA SA MAKATI

WATCH: Students from the Medicine, Health Sciences, and Multimedia and Digital Arts programs of Mapúa University Makati staged a protest along Pablo Ocampo Street on November 13, 2025, condemning widespread corruption and government inaction.

The demonstrators called for accountability over the systemic failures that led to the deaths of more than 200 Filipinos in the recent onslaught of Typhoons Tino and Uwan. | via Jonas Sulit, Abante
